cohort: 150 pregnant women at or beyond 34 weeks of gestation
finding: Decreased amniotic fluid index was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including increased rates of preterm delivery, small for gestational age babies, low birth weight babies, and neonatal deaths.
mod_finding: The abstract mentions mode of delivery (C-section vs. vaginal) as an outcome but does not report specific findings related to it.
followup_time: up to 40 weeks gestation or delivery/C-section
birth_weight: low birth weight (specific values not provided)
